The '''House of Imite''' (Japanese: '''モノマネハウス''' ''Mimic House'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kanto]], found in-between the {{Safari|Kanto}} and [[Cinnabar Island]]. It appeared in ''[[EP037|Ditto's Mysterious Mansion]]''.

Home to [[Duplica]] and her {{TP|Duplica|Ditto}}, the House of Imite is where Duplica keeps all of her disguises. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} stumbled across it while seeking shelter from a storm. They found what appeared to be a replica of Ash waiting inside, but it turned out to be Duplica imitating him. Eventually, Duplica formally introduced herself and explained to them who she was and what she did.

The House of Imite is also where Duplica and her Ditto perform shows for audiences. People come from all around to watch Duplica and her Ditto {{m|Transform}} together into Pokémon and people. However, for a while, people stopped coming because her Ditto couldn't transform all the way. Eventually, with the help of {{TRT}}, it learned how to Transform completely. Satisfied, Duplica reopened the House for audiences once again.
